brief:
The International Court of Justice will deliver its judgment on Myanmar's alleged genocide of Rohingya Muslims, according to Middle East Eye. The ruling tests whether the court will hold a state responsible for genocide under international law.

The case carries broader implications as South Africa pursues its own genocide case against Israel at the ICJ. Myanmar's judgment will establish precedent for how the world's top court applies genocide conventions in state-to-state disputes.

title: ICJ to rule on Myanmar genocide case against Rohingya Muslims
